[1] 5
[2] 1
[3] 4
[4] 0
[5] 2
[6] 3
sample.analysis: The visible bottle elements are ['frost', 'frost', 'void', 'void', 'frost']. The element sun appears 0 times, so choose option 4.

rules: heat: selected bottle potency increases by 1 up to 5.
cool: selected bottle potency decreases by 1 down to 1.
infuse: selected bottle element advances one step in the cycle ember -> sun -> leaf -> frost -> moon -> void -> ember.
decant: two selected bottles swap positions.
A cauldron mix has element equal to the cyclic sum of bottle elements and potency equal to 1 + (sum of potencies mod 5).
